description: Least privilege for every Wisp window: event listen/unlisten and window drag/close only (internal-toggle-maximize is what Tauri's data-tauri-drag-region double-click invokes; it is a no-op for non-maximizable windows). No core:default, which would also grant tray/menu/image/path/emit APIs to the WebView. Plugin JS APIs are never used; app commands are allowed by default because there is no app ACL manifest. Add a permission only together with the frontend code that needs it.
